label: sec:orbital-symmetry-embedding-intro
html: At shell level n, the orbital state space identifies with the space of holomorphic sections of the normal bundle to \Sigma_4 \subset \mathbb{P}^4. Decomposing these sections into Fourier modes under the icosahedral and S_5 automorphism actions yields the five-fold non-crystallographic golden-ratio scaling \varphi = (1+\sqrt{5})/2 across the five affine charts, assigns each fundamental knot basis element its colour content, and identifies the trivial unknot 0_1 with the colour-neutral photon sector.
